device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC compact satellite receiver with built-in Wi-Fi and external IR sensor
device.board: 67010A00 (bootloader version "3510CA 1.1.1", 128 MB DDR3 single-CPU C3503C platform)
device.soc: ALi M3510C / C3503C (chip word 0x3503C000, SDK chip code 0x10050, OTP 0x210 product 5)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_Mira_1.1.74_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, matched by C3503C_GUARD, chip word 0x3503C000, OTP 0x210 product 5, run_dump_mira_wifi_app_starts.py, run_dump_mira_wifi_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM SRAM bootloader ("3510CA 1.1.1") copies itself to 0x81000000, verifies the CRC of maincode(AV), unpacks 13.9 MB (0xD42424 bytes) to 0x80000200 and enters the application (CP0 EBase 0x80002000).  The application initialises hs_config_init and userdb(64+64), probes the DVB-S2 tuner over bit-banged GPIO I2C on SCL = GPIO 4 / SDA = GPIO 3, and draws its 4-colour 1280x720 CLUT8 OSD dialog through GeM36F / GMA layer 0 (9 GE commands).

desc: Amiko Mira WiFi EMU firmware v1.1.74 (System ID 67010A00) for the first-generation compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver with built-in Wi-Fi on the single-CPU ALi M3510C / C3503C SoC (128 MB DDR3, 8 MB SPI flash).
Predecessor to the Amiko Mira2 WiFi (C3503D, System ID 73010A00): uses the 3510CA 1.1.1 boot-ROM bootloader and C3503C chip code 0x10050 (chip word 0x3503C000).
